summary.name: APIDNA
summary.one_liner: APIDNA builds vertically-trained AI agent systems for enterprise operational workflows, such as reconciliation and regulatory reporting.
use_cases: moving AI agent pilots into production

summary.what_it_does: The page is an essay arguing that enterprise AI agent pilots fail to reach production because general-purpose models lack domain knowledge, integration patterns, and regulatory knowledge. It says the agents that succeed were built with vertical, domain-specific training from the start rather than prompting a general model. APIDNA is described as a company that builds vertically-trained agentic systems for enterprise environments, and visitors are invited to get in touch. The page names no specific product features, pricing, or technical implementation details.
notable: Argues vertical domain training is required for reliable production AI agents
Targets regulated enterprise workflows such as reconciliation and regulatory reporting
Custom build and consulting-style engagement; contact to evaluate
caveats: No public product details, features, or pricing on the page
Mainly marketing essay; capabilities are claimed rather than demonstrated
Enterprise-oriented; engagement requires contacting the company
